card.name: The letter C starting a word
card.fires_on: The letter C (or 'c') standing alone as the start of a word, usually right after a space, quote mark or slash, where the rest of the word follows in the next piece.

modes.label: Word-initial C after quote or space
modes.description: A lone C begins a capitalized or lowercase word such as a name or term.

modes.label: C after a slash or joining term
modes.description: A lone c starts a second drug or term after a slash or run-together word.
modes.example: ritonavir tablet<</c>>apsule, taken once daily with food

modes.label: C inside a drug name
modes.description: The piece 'ac' or 'c' appears inside a longer drug or medical word.

card.writes: It promotes word endings like 'ure' and suppresses 'therapy' forms, so it seems to steer away from 'therapy' words after a C.
card.plain: It fires when a word begins with a lone letter C that is spelled out in separate pieces.
